# Extended Data Analysis

## Tasks
For all datasets:

- identify keys & joins / relationships

For each dataset:

- List requirements based on analysis roadmap
- Review dataset for completeness
  - Required fields
  - Field types (categorical, numeric, etc.) & formatting issues
  - Null or duplicate fields or records
- Review descriptive statistics
  - Summary stats
  - Visualize the distribution & identify outliers
  - Correlation analysis
  - Time-based plots (if applicable)
